title: エリザベス女王杯の後に・Respect

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion wins splendidly at the Queen Elizabeth II Cup! Following the race, Air Groove congratulates her on her win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thunderous applause and cheers of support echo throughout the venue. Fine Motion's spirited run surely left a deep impression in the memories of everyone who watched!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With this incredible race behind us, Fine Motion and I happily wonder what to do tomorrow. There are only a few months left before she goes back to Ireland… which means there's still time to enjoy Japan!
